sections.theory:
Liquid fuel should not be kept in workrooms for a long duration.

Store liquid fuel, empty buckets and half-used ones in a safe place.

Liquid fuel should not leak from the container.

Some chemicals are very dangerous. Great care should be taken in using and storing them.

Fire-safety poster (as printed in English)

In case of fire…: 1. —; 2. Gather everyone; 3. Walk through the nearest exit; 4. Close any doors behind you to slow down the spread of fire; 5. —

Every home should have an escape plan.

Fire extinguisher: 1. Pull pin; 2. Hold; 3. Squeeze; 4. Sweep.

PASS — Pull the pin; Aim at the base of fire; Squeeze lever and handle; Sweep from side to side.

Do you know: the time you have to escape from fire; the number of deaths of children in fire incidents per year worldwide; the percentage of risk reduced by working smoke alarms; smoke inhaling kills more people than fire does.

Common causes of home fire: unattended stove; candles/burners; LPG leakage; electrical malfunction.

Oxygen

Oxygen is very necessary for the life of living things. In air there is 21% oxygen. Besides the life of living beings, oxygen is brought into industrial use. In industrial use oxygen is used in welding, flame cutting, breathing, medical, keeping food safe and packing, work of steel and chemical plants.
